summary.text: NORDVEST ANLEGG AS is a private limited company registered in Fosnavåg, founded 2017-07-07. Nordvest Anlegg AS carries on contracting business (entreprenørvirksomhet), as well as the sale of goods and services that naturally belong to this activity. Its main industry code is 43.120: site preparation. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 11 785 269 NOK and the annual result was 43 565 NOK; operating income was up from 9 754 647 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -605 465 NOK in 2024 to 43 565 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 2 168 187 NOK in 2024 to 2 211 752 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 5 on 2025-11-12 to 6 on 2026-05-12. The register's most recent update was on 2026-08-01 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
